title: Entity Extractor & Salience Profiler
short: Pull entities out of your content with Google's Natural Language API, then roll them up into one profile per URL — so you can see which pages are about something other than what you intended.
needs: A Google Cloud API key with the Cloud Natural Language API enabled
cost: Free for most audits — 5,000 units a month, then $1 per 1,000
inputs: Paste one page, or upload a crawl export with a URL column and a content column
how: Paste your API key. It stays in this browser tab and is sent only to Google.
Start with a single page so you can see the shape of the data before spending anything.
Set the intended entity — what the page is supposed to be about.
Read the table: the top row is what a machine thinks the page is about.
Then upload your whole crawl and export both CSVs.
note: Use API version 1. Version 2 does not return a salience score at all, and every prominence measure here depends on it.
